_internalReasoning: Scanned all supermarket snack shelf products and categorized into 4 ranked groups based on deep-fried status, portion size, and nutritional impact given the user's high calorie, saturated fat, and sodium status.
comparisonTitle: Supermarket Snack Shelf Product Evaluation & Ranking
summary: Evaluation of the supermarket snack shelf reveals ultra-processed, calorie-dense, and sodium-heavy fried snacks (NOVA 4). Given your elevated calorie, sodium, and saturated fat status, all items here represent significant metabolic challenges. Smaller pouches and baked-style corn snacks offer relative portion control compared to massive family bags.

items.name: Happy Tos Tortilla Chips Corn Chips

groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike massive family-size bags, these smaller single-serving snack pouches strictly limit total calorie, sodium, and saturated fat intake.
groups.message: These individual-sized snack pouches and popcorn bags help enforce hard portion boundaries, which is crucial since you are currently exceeding your calorie and sodium targets. While still ultra-processed (NOVA 4) with refined carbohydrates and added sodium, consuming a small single pouch prevents the runaway caloric surplus common with large bags. Enjoy strictly in moderation as an occasional treat.
groups.orderingTip: Choose the smallest available single-serve pouch and avoid multipacks that invite repeat consumption.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Standard Tortilla and Corn Chips
groups.comparisonSentence: These standard corn and tortilla chips deliver moderate per-serving macros but contribute heavily to your excess sodium and fat limits.
groups.message: Standard retail corn and tortilla chips provide quick energy from refined corn masa and vegetable oils, but they lack dietary fiber and essential micronutrients. Given that your current 3-day averages show significant excess in saturated fat and sodium, consuming these chips will further aggravate your metabolic load. Pair with raw vegetable sticks or limit portion sizes strictly.
groups.orderingTip: Portion out a small handful into a separate bowl instead of eating directly from the large bag.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Large Family Pack Fried Snacks
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to single-serve packs, these large family packs present an extreme metabolic hazard due to runaway fat and sodium.
groups.message: These large family-size fried cassava and chip packs are exceptionally dense in calories, total fat, and sodium, directly conflicting with your goals to correct elevated caloric and sodium intake. Unrestricted snacking from family packs virtually guarantees exceeding daily limits. Avoid purchasing these large formats entirely to remove temptation.
groups.orderingTip: Do not buy family-size formats; opt out entirely or choose unflavoured whole-food alternatives.
